verdict.rationale: The pack only shows chat/message export APIs (ms-teams-docs-13, ms-teams-docs-14) for compliance/eDiscovery, not audit logs of admin/user actions across the workspace (e.g., sign-ins, policy changes, admin actions) as tracked in Microsoft Purview/Office 365 audit log. No evidence cites such an audit log feature, its retention, or search/export tooling for admin actions.
